title: Your Hospital Bill Is an Opening Offer — Save $2,400
hook: The hospital sent you a $6,900 bill like it's non-negotiable — but 90% of medical bills can be reduced, and most people just pay the sticker price.
angle: Medical bills are the most negotiable invoices most people ever receive, with built-in charity care programs, rampant billing errors, and discount protocols hospitals never advertise — and almost no one knows to ask.
audience: Anyone who has received or expects to receive medical bills, especially those with high deductibles or partial insurance coverage
key_numbers: 80% of medical bills contain at least one billing error
Hospitals legally required to publish charity care programs
Average savings from negotiating: 30–40%, roughly $2,400 on a $6,900 bill
